snippet.title: Anant Express | Official Reveal Trailer (2025) | Psychological Horror Game
snippet.description:
You Woke Up On The Wrong Train…
A train that shouldn’t exist.
Passengers that don’t speak.
Whispers behind closed compartments.
And something watching… just out of sight.

This is Anant Express — a first-person psychological horror game where reality twists, shadows lie, and the only way forward… is through.


🎮 WISHLIST ON STEAM — before the train leaves the station::
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720550/Anant_Express/

💬 Drop your theories in the comments.
🔁 Share this with someone who loves unraveling psychological and Horror games.
